subject: 🏃 Thursday — 10 mi Progression Run (Wk 10 Peak)
html:
Tomorrow you have a 10-mile progression run — 8 miles easy, then 2 miles at threshold by HR. This is the biggest midweek run of the entire build, and the last quality session before Sunday's 20-mile race-format referendum. 17 days to race day.

HR governs everything. Easy block (mi 1–8): HR ≤145 BPM (Z2), pace readout ~9:00 on the hilly door route — let it float with the terrain. Threshold finish (mi 9–10): HR 155–165 BPM, cap at 165, pace readout ~7:15–7:25. Don't chase pace on the hills — hold the HR band and accept whatever pace the road gives you.

Pre-run activation + posterior-chain warm-up: Standard 5-min block (quadruped hip CARs, banded lateral walks, glute bridges, banded hip IR 5–10/side), then the hamstring protocol — 2×10 dynamic leg swings per side (forward/back + lateral), 10 walking hamstring reaches per side, 10 glute bridges. Foam-roll posterior chain before heading out.

Hamstring gate (non-negotiable): If the right hamstring twinges during the easy block, skip the threshold finish entirely — run the last 2 miles easy. Three faint appearances in 11 days (Jun 24, Jul 1, Jul 5) means we respect the pattern, not test it. Protecting the hamstring for Sunday's 20-miler is worth more than any threshold dose.

Hydration: Carry ~16 oz water + ½ LMNT (~500 mg sodium). Sip every 15–20 min. Ten hilly miles will take ~85–90 min. No fueling needed — this is under the 75-min/10-mi gel threshold, and you'll be home before glycogen matters. Eat a proper dinner tonight and a normal pre-run breakfast 2–3 hours out.

Focus cue: Control the descents — quick cadence, shortened stride, stay tall. The hilly door route is SF-course rehearsal, and disciplined downhills protect both the knee and the hamstring.

Where you are: Week 10 of 12, Phase 3 Peak Volume — the biggest week of the build (~48 mi). You're in the thick of it. Sunday's 20-miler is the race-format referendum: it decides Full Marathon vs. First Half. Get through tomorrow clean and you're perfectly positioned for that dress rehearsal. Bed by 10, gear laid out, alarm set.
